capabilities: Play and edit xiangqi games from PGN files and xiangqi code blocks
Analyze positions with the built-in Pikafish engine, including eval bars, arrows, and ghost lines
Navigate and annotate variation trees with keyboard shortcuts and pinned comments
Set up positions with a visual FEN board editor
Export boards as PNG snapshots and animated GIFs
extras: Licensed under GPL-3.0 with English and Chinese UI; some settings (code block names, file extensions) only take effect after restarting the plugin or Obsidian; available on the official community plugin marketplace.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to play, view, or analyze xiangqi games stored as PGN files or embedded in notes.

relations.evidence: Engine: Pikafish-wasm — single-threaded Asyncify WASM port of Pikafish
combine it with a fullscreen plugin (e.g. obsidian-full-screen-cross-platform-plugin)

summary: Interactive Chinese chess (xiangqi) player for Obsidian with PGN file support, embedded boards, variation trees, and built-in Pikafish engine analysis.
